attacks.name: Studied Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this character has already attacked the defender this Turn, add 3 dice to this attack roll.

attacks.name: Bullseye
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
The defender cannot modify its defense dice during this attack.

attacks.name: I Know Your Moves Better Than You
steps: The defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to its defense roll from |!critical| results.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_medium|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Death Dancer
superPowers.body: While attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may change 1 of its attack dice to a |!hit| for each |!critical| in the opposing defense roll. While defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may change 1 of its defense dice to a |!block| for each |!critical| in the opposing attack roll.

superPowers.name: On the Prowl
superPowers.body: While this character is within |!range| 1 of a terrain feature of |!size| 2 or more, this character gains the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower.
